name: IQM Quantum Computers
description: IQM Quantum Computers is a European leader in building superconducting quantum computers. Based in Finland, IQM provides on-premises quantum computers and partners with EuroHPC to integrate quantum accelerators into European supercomputing centers. IQM focuses on application-specific co-design for industrial quantum advantage.

products.name: IQM Spark
products.description: Compact 5-qubit superconducting quantum computer designed for research labs and educational institutions

products.name: IQM Radiance
products.description: High-performance superconducting quantum processor for national computing centers and industrial co-design

highlights: Europe's largest quantum computing company with 250+ employees and EUR 200M+ in funding
Supplies quantum accelerators to EuroHPC supercomputing centers across Europe
On track to become one of Europe's first publicly listed quantum computing companies

news.title: IQM Appoints Craig Ciesla, Former Illumina VP, as CTO; Inés de Vega Becomes Chief Scientist
news.excerpt: IQM announces leadership changes with Craig Ciesla joining as Chief Technology Officer and Inés de Vega becoming Chief Scientist.

news.title: Finland's IQM to become one of Europe's first listed quantum companies at $1.8 billion valuation
news.excerpt: IQM announces plans for an initial public offering via SPAC merger with Real Asset Acquisition Corp, targeting a New York primary listing with $1.8 billion valuation and possible dual listing on Helsinki stock exchange.

news.title: IQM to Deploy Japan's First Enterprise-Purchased Quantum Computer
news.excerpt: IQM Quantum Computers reaches agreement with TOYO Corporation for deployment of IQM Radiance 20-qubit system, marking Japan's first enterprise-purchased quantum computer with scheduled delivery by end of 2026.

news.title: IQM launches HPC Integration Service to run quantum computers as Slurm nodes in supercomputing centers
news.excerpt: Turnkey service integrates IQM Radiance systems into Slurm-managed HPC environments via the open-source QDMI interface, enabling quantum jobs to be submitted alongside CPUs and GPUs. Already running in production at LRZ Munich.

news.title: IQM to deploy 54-qubit Radiance system at Polish enterprise Galaxy
news.excerpt: First installation of an IQM Radiance-class quantum system inside a private enterprise, scheduled for Q4 2026.

news.title: IQM introduces AI-powered calibration to make quantum computing enterprise-ready
news.excerpt: Agentic AI calibration using NVIDIA Ising models automates parallel qubit tuning, targeting HPC data-centre deployments.

news.title: IQM deploys Japan's first enterprise quantum computer to TOYO Corporation
news.excerpt: TOYO Corporation purchased a 20-qubit IQM Radiance system for delivery by end of 2026, marking the first enterprise quantum computer deployment in Japan and expanding IQM's Asia-Pacific installed base.

news.title: IQM files Form F-4 with SEC, advancing NASDAQ listing as IQMX via SPAC merger with Real Asset Acquisition Corp.
news.excerpt: IQM Finland Oy and Real Asset Acquisition Corp. publicly filed a Form F-4 registration statement with the SEC on May 14, 2026. IQM intends to list American Depositary Shares on the NASDAQ Global Exchange under ticker IQMX, targeting position as Europe's first listed quantum computing company.

news.title: IQM Launches HPC Integration Service to Accelerate Hybrid Quantum-HPC Adoption
news.excerpt: IQM launched a turnkey service integrating its superconducting quantum computers as Slurm nodes in HPC environments via its open-source QDMI protocol, already operational at the Leibniz Supercomputing Centre in Germany. The service targets data-centre deployments as IQM advances its planned public listing.

news.title: IQM Moves Closer to Public Markets With SEC F-4 Filing
news.excerpt: IQM Finland Oy filed an SEC Form F-4 registration statement in connection with its planned merger with Real Asset Acquisition Corp. (Nasdaq: RAAQ), targeting a listing under proposed ticker 'IQMX'. The transaction values IQM at approximately $1.8 billion, with over $300 million expected from SPAC trust proceeds and PIPE financing.

news.title: Poznan University of Technology deploys IQM Radiance R1 — Poland's second IQM installation
news.excerpt: PUT unveiled its first locally installed quantum computer, an IQM Radiance R1, supporting new engineering and master's degree programs in quantum technologies starting October 2026 and a Polish Quantum Olympiad for secondary school students.

news.title: IQM secures €50M financing from BlackRock ahead of public listing
news.excerpt: Funds managed by BlackRock provided a €50M financing facility to accelerate IQM's technology roadmap, R&D, and market expansion ahead of its planned Nasdaq dual listing at a USD 1.8B pre-money valuation.

news.title: IQM and RAAQ upsize PIPE financing to USD 146M ahead of Nasdaq and Helsinki listing
news.excerpt: Ilmarinen, Finland's largest pension insurer, committed an additional USD 12M, bringing total PIPE commitments above USD 146M. The SPAC merger values IQM at approximately USD 1.8B pre-money; RAAQ shareholder vote scheduled for 25 June 2026.

news.title: IQM announces barbell QLDPC codes reducing logical error rates 1,000x with 8x fewer physical qubits
news.excerpt: IQM's new barbell code family of quantum low-density parity-check (QLDPC) codes, tailored to IQM's 12-connectivity Constellation processor, achieves up to 1,000x lower logical error rates than the surface code while requiring 8x fewer physical qubits. The arXiv preprint (2606.06062) details the hardware-native design requiring no complex multi-layer wiring.

news.title: IQM's 54-qubit Radiance system NOX goes live at CINECA, integrated with Italy's Leonardo supercomputer
news.excerpt: The IQM Radiance 54 quantum computer, named NOX, was inaugurated at CINECA's national supercomputing center in Bologna, Italy, and integrated with Leonardo—one of Europe's fastest supercomputers—enabling hybrid classical-quantum workflows for optimization, simulation, and machine learning research.

news.title: IQM Quantum Computers begins trading on Nasdaq as first European quantum company on a major U.S. exchange
news.excerpt: IQM (ticker: IQMX) began trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market on July 2, 2026, following completion of its business combination with Real Asset Acquisition Corp. IQM entered trading with 23 quantum computers sold globally and approximately EUR 198.7 million in net SPAC proceeds.
